So difference: Standard: 9 hours (Berlin ahead). During DST: Los Angeles DST (UTC-7) vs Berlin DST (UTC+2) difference still 9 hours. Actually both shift same offset? Let's check: In summer, LA is UTC-7, Berlin is UTC+2, difference 9 hours. In winter, LA is UTC-8, Berlin is UTC+1, difference 9 hours. So always 9 hours difference. So answer: 9 hours ahead.
